info.title: BhagyaRekha public API
info.description: Read-only public API. Every response carries dataMode; demo deployments serve synthetic fixtures only. Generated from packages/contracts — do not edit by hand.

get.summary: List lotteries with localized names and archive coverage
List draws (metadata only) ordered by display date, newest first
Latest published draw and, separately, the pending draw
Draw identity, dates, visibility, current revision summary and checking capability
Current published result: category manifest and paginated entries

post.summary: Compare a ticket with one published revision. Ephemeral: the ticket is never stored, logged or echoed.
